system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
Your goal is to improve the test suite at { test_file } to
achieve ** broad - coverage ** of the code below .
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt template with {test_file} and {code_src} variables; paper-only. Quote spans line break in extracted text.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
we prompt the LLM with the code
under test, and ask it to generate an initial test suite
env_context_strategy.note: Code under test injected into prompt ({code_src}) plus agent-driven navigation (search/view tools, Sec. 3.2.1, 3.2.4). Injected content is the file under test rather than a tree summary.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no config surface for history processing. View limited to 400 lines (Sec. 3.2.4) but that is a tool window, not compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
The output from this tool
call includes whether the command succeeded or failed, and all
terminal output (stdout and stderr).

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
We provide a list of available agent actions and their correspond-
ing input and output formats as tools when calling OpenAI's API.

tool_count.note: Actions described (navigate, write, edit, insert, view, bash, run tests, coverage) but exact tool schema list not given; repo not in evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
The command takes in both original text and
replacement text.
edit_primitive.note: Write file = whole_file_rewrite (Sec. 3.2.2); insert lines = line_range_edit (Sec. 3.2.3).

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote:
Listing 2 shows how we define both our agent actions and in-
teractions with the environment in LiteLLM4 as tools.
tool_schema_source.note: JSON tool definitions shown in Listing 2 appear hand-authored.

protocol_standardization.note: No repository or dependency list available to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
then continuously refines those tests based on feedback from
test executions and coverage reports.
loop_primitives.note: Zero-shot generation then agentic CodeAct loop; test/coverage feedback is agent-invoked.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
we show TestForge the command output and ask it to plan
out subsequent steps systematically.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
as we build off of
the CodeAct agent.

delegation_mechanism.note: No agent config surface in evidence.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
TestForge can either perform an agent
command
short_term_state.note: Inferred from prose; no state object described.

self_verification.evidence_quote:
we require TestForge
to reflect on the output of any interaction with the environment.
self_verification.note: Test/coverage runs are agent-invoked, not harness-enforced, so test_execution not coded.

retry_policy.note: Paper only; malformed-action requery is step-level.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
signified by executing the
bash command exit or 25 iterations have elapsed

cost_controls.note: Cost reported ($0.63/file) but no control mechanism described.

timeouts.note: One-hour timeout is for mutation evaluation, not the harness.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
We run all commands in a docker im-
age with the dependencies for TestForge and the individual project

network_policy.note: Prompt says no external help, but no network config surface available.

tracing.note: Action frequency analysis (Fig. 5) implies trajectories logged, but mechanism not described.
